QuestInfo.name: Regaining Confidence
QuestInfo.0: You handed Power B. Fore his precious letter of commendation, but he seems upset that there's a stain on it.
QuestInfo.1:
He's so enraged about the stain that he wants you to get revenge on the monsters.
